name: Hi-Fi RUSH
notes: This is the flagged case, and it resolves against the naive assumption. Hi-Fi RUSH originated as an Xbox Game Studios / Bethesda title, but after Tango Gameworks' 2024 closure, Microsoft SOLD Tango Gameworks AND the Hi-Fi RUSH franchise to Krafton (announced Aug 2024). Ownership is now third-party (Krafton), not Microsoft. Despite that, the title is confirmed CURRENTLY on Xbox Game Pass Premium tier as of the Aug 2026 lineup check — Microsoft evidently retained or renegotiated a distribution licence with Krafton. Net effect for the board: no acquisition or new licence is needed or even available in the usual sense; it is already in the subscription under an existing arrangement with the new rights-holder.

sources.claim: Krafton acquires Tango Gameworks and Hi-Fi Rush franchise from Microsoft
Krafton snaps up Tango Gameworks and Hi-Fi Rush IP
